items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: That was with Wild Bill -- Wild Bill Davison, Edmund Hall, Cutty Cutshall

ctx.x: This is tape four of the Cliff Leeman story, and now Cliff Leeman will continue with his Condon story.

To get back to the Condon band, when I went in with Eddie in '51, that band was the most charging band, the most exciting -- I don't believe they ever had a bad night. I can't remember a bad night there. That was with Wild Bill -- Wild Bill Davison, Edmund Hall, Cutty Cutshall, Schroeder Gene Shrader -- Shrader Shroder -- take your pick.

I got Walter Page, I recommended Walter Page for the job, and Ralph Sutton, Lou McGerrity, and -- in those days, the place was jammed. I've seen them hang from the -- there was a railing around the top there, there was an upper part, and they'd come down from West Point, the Army-Navy games and so forth. And we played with that band, all the traditional Dixieland songs, because they were requested. They were references -- it was a Dixie style orchestra, which it was not.
